response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount, AVG(e.fillcount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.timespan) AS tif_avg FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill, MAX(tif_avg) AS tif_avg FROM j GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS excess_over_tif, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk, tif_avg FROM per_order) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess_over_tif, rnk FROM ranked WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg AND rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark

assumptions.assumption: The time-in-force figure is the plain average of fillcount over all matched execution records for that timespan (each execution weighted equally, NULLs ignored), not an average of the per-order averages.
Rank is computed among all orders with executions in the same timespan (before the above-average filter); this gives the same ranks as ranking only the kept orders.
orders.recordvault is unique per order, so grouping by ordersmark identifies one order.
